## Findings

- [ ] F1 (blocker) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:121` — The blueprint binds one universal construction constant, while every linked Lean estimate independently quantifies its own constant.
- [ ] F2 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:79` — The blueprint uses basis indices `1,...,t`, while the linked Lean declarations use zero-indexed `Fin P.model.basisDim`.
- [ ] F3 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:200` — `\notready` incorrectly represents an open proof as an unsettled statement, and the support entry lacks `\uses`.
- [ ] F4 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:115` — The robustness comparison has an explicit blueprint counterpart but no blueprint traceability entry.
- [ ] F5 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:15` — The full-field decoder and the linearity, inverse, encoding, and restricted-evaluation statements asserted here lack formal blueprint entries.
- [ ] F6 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:35` — Three definition entries include projectivity or completeness theorems and must separate those facts into lemma or theorem entries.
- [ ] F7 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:15` — “raw global-witness error” is process-shaped terminology; use “global polynomial-pair consistency error.”
- [ ] F8 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Decoding.lean:83` — Decoder docstrings use prohibited implementation vocabulary including “Lean-only,” “raw,” “Package,” “constructor,” and “subtype wrapper.”
- [ ] F9 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/LowDegreeCodeTheorems.lean:7` — “raw polynomial specialization” and “`Poly` API” should be replaced by mathematical descriptions of the representative-level decoder.
- [ ] F10 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:6` — The extraction docstrings repeatedly use private implementation language including “bookkeeping,” “landed,” “Lean-only,” “raw,” and “API.”
- [ ] F11 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:42` — “raw global-witness error” and “The Lean conclusion” should directly describe the two mathematical error parameters.

## Review

The truncated attachment was supplemented with the complete `diff.patch` and checked-out sources.

F1 is the principal equivalence mismatch. The blueprint declares one common \(C\) and hence one \(\delta_P\), but the linked declarations at `Consistency.lean:48`, `:80`, `:132`, `:158`, `:185`, and `:212` each begin with a separate `∃ C`; `exists_extractionWitness` introduces another at `Unitary.lean:88`. No linked signature states all displayed conclusions under the same quantified constant. Provide a joint source-facing statement with one outer constant, or explicitly distinguish the constants and error scales in the blueprint.

F2 affects every occurrence at lines 79, 95, 100, 150, 268, and 317. For example, `tildeObs` quantifies `j : Fin P.model.basisDim` at `Observables.lean:118`. Use \(j\in\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\), or explicitly give the reindexing from the paper’s convention.

F3 should retain `\lean{MIPStarRE.QPBT.nonencodingMarginalMass_le}` as a standalone traceability entry without `\leanok`, because its proof remains open. Remove `\notready` and add dependencies for the marginal, encoding predicate, construction error, and Schwartz--Zippel argument.

F4 and F5 concern missing traceability for open internal obligations. Add subordinate formalization-support entries without `\leanok` for `deltaExtract_le_deltaQld` and for the decoder laws at `Decoding.lean:112`, `:123`, `:136`, and `:151`. Record `decodeFq` and `IsEncoding` separately as definitions rather than placing unfinished laws inside an existing source-labelled `\leanok` block.

For F6, the assertions at blueprint lines 46, 59, and 72 are facts, represented respectively by `marginalPoly_isProjective`, `tauDotProj_isProj`/`sum_tauDotProj_eq_one`, and `tildeM_isProj`/`sum_tildeM_eq_one`. Move them into separate lemma or theorem environments; leave the definition entries for the objects themselves.

For F7-F11, representative replacements are “global-witness consistency error,” “evaluation of the bounded polynomial representative,” “representative-level decoder,” “chosen six-register order,” and “placement map.” Describe the mathematical mappings directly instead of their Lean representation or file-layer role.

Prior-round triage: the extraction witness now includes both unitarity equations at `Unitary.lean:45-49`, resolving that earlier mismatch. The former “packages the output” and “definitional bridge” wording is gone. Prior naming-style and paper-gap-documentation findings belong to the other review lane; the remaining in-scope issues are represented above.
